		if = {
			limit = {
				estate_satisfaction = {
					estate_type = scope:estate
					value < 0.20

			add_estate_satisfaction = {
				type = scope:estate
				value = 0.60
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				estate_satisfaction = {
					estate_type = scope:estate
					value < 0.40
				}
			}
			add_estate_satisfaction = {
				type = scope:estate
				value = 0.40
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				estate_satisfaction = {
					estate_type = scope:estate
					value < 0.60
				}
			}
			add_estate_satisfaction = {
				type = scope:estate
				value = 0.20
			}
		}
	}
